deployment_verification.description: ALWAYS verify deployments with live browser screenshots before claiming code is live

workflow.step_1: Invoke /vercel-deployment-check with description of expected changes
workflow.step_2: Skill opens live browser and takes screenshots
workflow.step_4: Report with proof - show user the screenshots
workflow.step_5: Only say 'it's live' if screenshots confirm it

deployment_checks.description: Can verify ANY type of change - theme, features, UI, styling, functionality
